{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A team of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] led an '''expedition''' to the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] shortly after a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] team of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had left with a load of [[Serianan statue|statues]] they had discovered within a [[The Gulch|cave]] in one of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of the [[Serianan Belt]]. The alien team, unaffiliated with the New Republic, set about trying to decipher a set of [[Serianan runes|runes]] in the belt and to tease out the history of the creation of the runes and the statues.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The alien [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] were careless about securing their find, and prospectors soon arrived hoping to exploit the Serianan Belt. A team of New Republic scouts soon [[Third expedition to the Serianan system|arrived]] to follow up on their earlier discoveries, and the newcomers teamed up with the aliens to rebuff the prospectors.
{{Endgame}}
